description: Public UI endpoints used by the Sam Rogers AI-queryable resume.

privacy.summary: The fit assessment and chat endpoints receive user-supplied text for AI analysis. Job descriptions are not intentionally stored by this app. Users should email confidential roles to sam@sam-rogers.com instead of submitting sensitive material through the form.

endpoints.purpose: Answer user questions about Sam Rogers' resume, evidence, gaps, portfolio, and role fit.
Compare a pasted job description against Sam Rogers' profile and return an honest role-fit assessment.

openapi.reason: These endpoints support the website UI rather than a public integration API.
